def execute_enigma_black_hole_dota(ctx, actor, target, cfg):
    # LORE INTENT: Summons a vortex that forcibly pulls enemies inward and prevents most responses.
    if not ctx.owns_ability(actor, ability_id): return NOT_OWNED
    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED
    tx = ctx.begin_effect(ability_id, actor, target)
    if not summon_preconditions_pass(actor,target): return DENIED
    for archetype in defined_summon_list(ability):
        entity = spawn_owned_entity_at_safe_location(archetype, actor)
        register_ai_team_and_lifetime(entity,actor)
    on_despawn_or_owner_death: apply_defined_roster_policy()
    tx.commit_if_valid()
    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
    return SUCCESS
